neighbours.label: the token ' martial' as an adjective (martial arts, martial law, martial music); quiet on karate/judo/military without the word and on 'court-martial'
fire: She opened a martial arts studio above the old bakery.
The president imposed martial law after the riots in the capital.
The film is famous for its martial arts scenes on the rooftops.
Under martial law the newspapers were closed for a month.
The band played martial music as the troops marched past.
My cousin teaches martial arts to children at the weekend.
The parliament voted to lift martial law before the election.
The old soldier kept a martial bearing even in retirement.
quiet: She opened a karate studio above the old bakery.
The president imposed a curfew after the riots in the capital.
The film is famous for its sword fighting scenes on the rooftops.
Under military rule the newspapers were closed for a month.
The band played marching music as the troops marched past.
My cousin teaches judo to children at the weekend.
The officer faced a court-martial before the election.
The old soldier kept a military bearing even in retirement.

notes: Card: ' martial' x6, 'artial', ' Mickey' x2, ' Mu' (Muay Thai), 'p' x2, 'ool'. Probes: ' martial' 0.47-0.86 in arts, law and 'martial discipline'; 'court-martial' 0.003, karate/judo 0.05, kung fu 0.14, taekwondo 0.05. 'Muay Thai' 0.60 and 'Mickey Mouse' 0.46 also fire (a bare 'uncle Mickey' 0.13) and are outside this label.
